title: 60ml DIY Chubby Gorilla Empty Bottle Pack of 5
description: This Chubby Gorilla PET unicorn bottle is specifically designed for e-liquid. It's a soft-squeeze PET shatterproof bottle, with a wide mouth for easy refil. The dripper has a tight fit to avoid any leaks and the drip tip is narrow enough to avoid over-dripping or spilling. The cap is child-resistant and the tamper evident seal is designed for complete safety and assurance. Ideal for those mixing their own e-liquids at home.
